name: Precise Cut

features.text: Removes P1000 grit and finer sanding scratches and surface defects
Effective on newer, harder to buff clear coats
Advanced micro abrasive technology for a controlled, consistent cut
No sticking, no dusting, no film residue
Extended work cycle reduces rework and pad loading

description: PRECISE ™ CUT is a micro abrasive compound formulated to effectively remove 1000 grit or finer sand scratches and surface defects. Formulated for longer work times and a wide range of user conditions without sticking, dusting, or film residue left behind. PRECISE ™ CUT is body shop safe and does not contain silicone, wax, or fillers.
application: Directions: For use with a DA polisher or rotary buffer. Apply product directly to a cool surface working a small area at a time approximately 2’ x 2’. Work product until it is almost dry. Wipe off excess material with a clean microfiber towel. Repeat process until desired results are achieved. Formulated to be used with wool pads or foams pads. DA Orbitals - use 70300 wool or 70325 foam cutting pads
